Definition: properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply
BiblicalUsage: The plain sense of geber is man, strong man, warrior (emphasising strength or ability to fight). It comes up 64 times, and the passages from Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and Joshua show how steadily Scripture uses it. I do not find a second, secret meaning hiding behind it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that geber matters because true strength belongs to the Lord, and He lends it to His people. I read this as a reminder that God’s words mean what they say, and I can trust them.
RelatedEvents: The Plague of Locusts; The Defeat at Ai and Achan's Sin
